text: こがねいろに　すき　とおった　きれいな　コハクが　ある！

structure.jp: こがねいろに　すき　とおった
きれいな　コハクが　ある！
structure.en: there is a beautiful piece of amber!

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: こがねいろに　すき　とおった　きれいな　コハク
patterns.explanation: A verb phrase placed right before a thing describes that thing; the past form here just tells the state it is in. すき とおった コハク = 'amber that is see-through'.

patterns.name: 〜に (result)
patterns.span: こがねいろに　すき　とおった
patterns.explanation: に after a colour word tells in what way the next verb happens, like '-ly' or 'in' in English. こがねいろに すき とおった = 'see-through in a golden colour'.

patterns.name: 〜な (na-adjective)
patterns.explanation: Describing words like きれい need な before the thing they describe. きれいな コハク = 'beautiful amber'.
